source_refs.note: Testcross: a main subheading of Monohybrid Cross, Its Interpretation and the Testcross, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 86-86.

blocks.text: Testcross se pata chalaya jata hai ke dominant phenotype wala fard homozygous hai ya heterozygous. Is mein dominant phenotype wale ko recessive phenotype wale se milaya jata hai. Misaal:

Gol beej wala paudha RR (homozygous) bhi ho sakta hai aur Rr (heterozygous) bhi, jab ke jhurridar beej wala paudha hamesha rr hota hai. Gol paude ka genotype maloom karne ke liye use jhurridar paude (rr) se milaya jata hai.

items: Agar woh RR hai to sab bachche gol (Rr) honge.
Agar woh Rr hai to bachche gol aur jhurridar 1:1 ratio mein honge.

blocks.title: Rozmarra ki misaal
blocks.text: Aik thaili sochiye jis mein do card hain, aik par R aur aik par r. Har walid aankh band kar ke apni thaili se aik card deta hai. Yahi ittefaqi intikhab segregation hai, aur isi liye Rr x Rr se har chaar mein se taqreeban aik bachcha rr hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Gol beej wale matar ka testcross (rr se) 52 gol aur 49 jhurridar bachche deta hai. Gol paude ka genotype kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Rr. rr ke saath testcross mein taqreeban 1:1 gol aur jhurridar sirf tab aate hain jab gol walid heterozygous ho. RR walid sirf gol (Rr) bachche deta.

items: Har fard ke paas har khasiyat ke do genes (alleles) hote hain; gamete ko sirf aik milta hai: law of segregation.
Aik jaise alleles: homozygous (RR, rr); mukhtalif alleles: heterozygous (Rr).
Gene: DNA par nucleotides ka silsila jo polypeptide ka code deta hai; locus: chromosome par gene ki jagah.
Testcross (rr ke saath): sab gol to RR; gol aur jhurridar 1:1 to Rr.
